method: CLI: fresh process, stdout pipe drained and retained, alternating variant order; engine: compiled plan reused in one process, visitor count or explicit parallel delivery. Filesystem cache uncontrolled; warmups are not cold-disk control.
correctness: Complete CLI path sets checked against deterministic generator manifest before timing; every timed output/count checked. Engine counts checked against the same manifest.
limitations: Engine variants run in separate blocks, reversing order between workloads.
First output chunk includes buffering and startup; it is not engine time to first match.
Windows resources are separate untimed samples; OS peak working set is sampled every 1 ms while alive and may miss the final peak. It is not allocator usage.
No external competitor speed claim; generated files are not a public-repository benchmark.
Batch child-process work is not timed by this suite.
